mentions.name: Anydrop.org
mentions.description: A zero-friction, cross-platform web app for sharing text and files between devices, positioned as an alternative to AirDrop. Any device with a browser can receive dropped text or files with no installation or login, and the service also offers realtime notepad sync and clipboard sharing for text snippets, with all shares end-to-end encrypted.
mentions.problem: Cross-device transfer tools like AirDrop are platform-limited and typically require installation or login; this project removes that friction with a browser-only, install-free flow.
mentions.audience: Anyone wanting to move text or files between devices with a browser, including pcs, macs, linux machines, phones, tablets and smart TVs
mentions.source_excerpt: Anydrop.org A zero-friction, cross-platform alternative to AirDrop. If your device have a browser, you can drop text or files to it. Doesn't matter if the device is a pc, mac, linux, phones, tablet or smart tv.
